metadata.title: Samsung launches 30 AI glasses with Google and eyewear brands

content.text:
Samsung Electronics has unveiled 30 AI smart-glasses models developed with Google, Gentle Monster and Warby Parker, marking its entry into the AI smart-glasses market...
